rationale: Genome-wide GeCKO v2 (A+B) knockout FACS screen in 293T cells carrying the translocation-stalled reporter ER-GFP-K20: knockouts that impair translocation-associated quality control stabilise the reporter and are enriched in the GFP-high sort. GEO characteristics map initial_rep1/2 to the GFP-low and final_rep1/2 to the GFP-high populations, two independent repeats. The paper ran MAGeCK test in paired mode (high and low sorted from the same culture); a replicate term would leave one residual degree of freedom, and the counts show no pairing (each GFP-high library correlates equally with both GFP-low libraries, Spearman 0.65-0.66), so the replicate term is left out (2 residual df). Raw counts come from the Raw_counts sheet of the deposited workbook (prepare.R). Controls are the 1000 GeCKO v2 non-targeting guides.
